- Technical deep dive (60–90 minutes) with our ML infra engineers and your Infra/Platform leads to walk architecture, sample load profile, and run a short live walkthrough.

1) Tue 2027-04-13 09:00–10:30 PT

3) Thu 2027-04-15 08:00–09:30 PT
(If none work, share a couple 60–90m windows and timezone.)

- NebulaOps: Infra/Platform lead, 1 data-engineer who owns model pipelines, security/compliance contact (if available)
- Redwood: Marissa (AM), Ben (Solutions), Karthik (Servicing/runtime eng), Grace (Customer Success)

- 0–10m: Intros & goals alignment
- 10–25m: NebulaOps high-level workload and constraints (you)
- 25–55m: Redwood runtime architecture + live flow (Karthik)
- 55–75m: Q&A + blockers (open)
- 75–90m: Next steps / mutual action plan (we attached MAP)

Can you confirm:
- Which of the proposed slots works for your team (and timezone)?
- Names/emails of attendees we should expect (so we can include correct technical owners)?
- Any pre-reqs (e.g., sample traces, telemetry, security questionnaire items) — I can start a thread with our SOC2 package if you need it.

Attachments: Mutual Action Plan - NebulaOps.xlsx (xlsx) — outline of milestones; TDX Agenda v0.2.pdf (pdf) — proposed timing.

Thanks — aiming to lock a time and send a calendar invite + short pre-read.
